message: I think my noticing it was probably in large part my thin-skinned intellectual vanity, and I should have been more clear in saying how I thought it might be perceived, rather than implying it was part of a conscious attitude -- since that'd be an extraordinarily rude thing for me to ascribe to you. Anyway -- fusses and fidgets aside, I hope my comments did the presentation justice -- I think the points you're making, especially when taken in conjunction with those made by Collin, Clancy, Fred Johnson, and Mike Palmquist, are extraordinarily important for humanities scholarship, and need to be made frequently and loudly. Somebody oughta write a *College English* article. . . .
